director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ground jaise shapes ka perimeter, yani boundary length, dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Riya, maan lo cricket pitch ke chaaron taraf rope lagani ho—tum total rope kaise sochogi? Aakhir mein tum Golu ko sikhaogi.
Haan Riya, lesson thodi der ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karna chahti ho? Screen ka button tumhe lesson par wapas laayega.
Theek hai Riya—perimeter mein polygon ki boundary ke sabhi sides jodte hain. Cricket ground ki boundary 4 sides ki ho, toh kaun-si lengths jodogi?
Riya, koi baat nahi—rectangle park ki length 50 m aur breadth 30 m hai. Ek round ka perimeter 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, yani 160 m.
Riya, game: main ek shape bolungi, tum uski boundary ke sides count karna. Rectangle mein kitni sides hoti hain?
Riya, rectangle ki 4 sides hoti hain; tumne 3 count kiya, ek chhoot gayi. Ab rectangle ki chaar sides ginke bolo.
Riya, sides-counting boring lag rahi hai—ab tareeka badalte hain: picture, story ya game, inmein se ek choose karke bolo.
Riya, tum kya choose karogi: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain?
Kahani mein socho: park ke chaaron taraf ek runner boundary ka poora chakkar lagata hai. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Theek hai Riya, tum aaj ke liye rukna chahti ho—carry on, short break, ya stop for today?
